newsitem.title: POLAND: BWR to issue new shares to buy real estate.
newsitem.headline: BWR to issue new shares to buy real estate.

text.p: Poland's Bank Wspolpracy Regionalnej SA (BWR) will issue new shares to buy real estate from three owners, the bank said in a statement on Monday.
"It will be an issue for these three specific real-estate owners, with whom we have reached an agreement," BWR's spokesman Franciszek Palowski told Reuters.

The property in the towns of Nowa Sol, Krakow and Tarnow, is earmarked for banking purposes, Palowski said, adding that the ex-rights issue would likely take place in the first half of 1997. The precise date will be set by shareholders at a meeting on December 23.
BWR's capital is 31,255,205 zlotys divided into 12,502,802 shares. BWR's net after 10 months of 1996 was 4.1 million zlotysagainst 2.4 million in the same period last year.
